title: Grateful Dead Live at Hampton Coliseum on 1979-05-04
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/96k) -> Samplitude Professional v9.12 -> FLAC/16
source: (FOB) Sony ECM-250 -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-158/Maxell UDXL-II90)

ai_review.summary: Good audience recording capturing a more aggressive late‑70s show highlighted by Brent’s creamy organ texture
ai_review.review: The audience tape is praised as great and vivid, delivering enough clarity to appreciate Brent Mydland’s richer organ tone that adds a new texture compared with the earlier Keith Godchaux era. The performance itself is described as unusually aggressive for the late‑70s, making it stand out among shows from that period.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one 4‑star review; both show performance and recording are described positively but without detailed metrics, so a solid but cautious rating is given.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer calls it a 'great audience recording' that feels like being there; no specific issues noted, indicating clear and immersive sound for an audience source.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific set‑list comments; reviewer focuses on overall aggressive vibe of the performance rather than individual song flow.

band_member_comments.Keys: Brent’s organ is described as creamier and adding a texture absent in Keith’s earlier playing, highlighting his positive impact on the band’s sound.
